text: [image]Apr 18, 2023 ∙ 5 minArkansas Education Legislation Summary - 94th General AssemblyARKANSAS EDUCATION LEGISLATION SUMMARY 2023 HB1688-This bill amends public school funding. It increases per-pupil funding from the current amount of $7,413 to $7,618 for the 2023-2024 school year. The bill would increase the amount to $7,771 for the 2024-2025 school year. Act 237-LEARNS Act Raises the minimum teacher salary to $50,000/year. It raises current teacher salaries (already making $50,000) by $2,000. In the second week, several bills passed the House and are now making their way to the Senate. On Wednesday, the House passed HB1018. This bill will allow members of municipal fire department bomb squads to carry weapons while responding to bomb threats. The House also passed HB1086. The session began on Monday, January 9 when members of the 94th General Assembly took the oath of office. The House then elected Matthew J. Shepherd of El Dorado as the Speaker for the 94th General Assembly. He is the first person in state history to be elected Speaker for a third term.
